internships.title: Frontend Intern
internships.description: Collaborate with cross-functional product teams to design and build accessible, responsive user interfaces. You will work on component systems, state management, and modern browser APIs.

internships.title: API Engineering Intern
internships.description: Develop and maintain secure, scalable RESTful microservices. You will optimize SQL database queries, implement automated unit/integration test suites, and write comprehensive API documentation.

internships.title: UI/UX Intern
internships.description: Conduct qualitative and quantitative user research, create low and high-fidelity prototypes in Figma, and ensure all design assets satisfy WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines.

internships.title: Data Analyst Intern
internships.description: Extract, transform, and analyze enterprise metrics. You will build interactive dashboards, perform statistical queries, and translate business intelligence into actionable insights.

internships.title: Security Operations Intern
internships.description: Assist our security operations center (SOC) with vulnerability scanning, real-time log analysis, intrusion detection alerts, and Linux server hardening practices.
